answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Re-attestations are stored in summit and raven lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4915 identities would post 4460 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
